---
name: debug-css
description: Use when the user wants to investigate a CSS or layout problem with temporary visual debugging changes.
user-invocable: true
disable-model-invocation: true
---

Temporarily modify the CSS code to identify the problem:

- Add borders in different colors and sizes where useful.
- Add a comment containing `🤡` near each temporary change so it can be found easily.

When the problem is solved, remove these temporary CSS changes.
